I had an appointment with Dr Sana Arif on 10 October 2025. I was dealing with several issues — all connected and highly emotional.

I began by describing my physical ailments, and right away I felt she was truly listening. She asked thoughtful questions to reach the root of my concerns, even as they began to touch on emotional matters too.

I rarely open up about emotional issues because it takes a sensitive and respectful ear. I usually keep things minimal, even when it’s essential to share. Most GPs don’t probe beyond what’s strictly necessary — but Dr Arif was different.

I felt I could trust her. Her tone, her gentle curiosity, her emotional investment, her genuine interest, and her realistic, meaningful reassurances all worked together to create that trust. (Not all reassurances from GPs make sense or feel believable — hers did.)

Because of that, I was able to let go and open up fully. I became very emotional — but in a way that felt safe and supported. I was genuinely allowed to go through the emotions needed to unpack and address my issues, and to find a plan I could feel confident about.

I wasn’t rushed. I wasn’t made to feel ashamed. I was allowed to not have all the answers. I was treated as a human being — with dignity, respect, and care.

After offloading all that emotional weight to a professional who truly acted like one, I felt I could breathe again. I actually took several deep breaths — for the first time in a long while.

I had never met this GP before. I didn’t expect the outcome of that appointment — not even to meet my most basic hopes for it. It’s taken me a couple of weeks to write this feedback because I’ve been busy dealing with ongoing issues, but that day has stayed with me. It made a real difference and continues to have a lasting effect. I owe Dr Arif a great deal of gratitude.

Thank you for being a light in the dark that day. I haven’t needed to see my GP since, but if I did, I wouldn’t expect you to have that same energy for every appointment. What gives me comfort is knowing that you care, that you’re capable, and that I can trust you to guide me when I need it.",null,[0,131]]]],[null,1762268408000000,1762268408000000,"4 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/17833839322467604636/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhZWsxRmEzZFVhbVJFVG0xT2MyUXpiR0ZPV0ZwWVRrVm9VMXB0WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17833839322467604636/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhZWsxRmEzZFVhbVJFVG0xT2MyUXpiR0ZPV0ZwWVRrVm9VMXB0WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/17833839322467604636/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhZWsxRmEzZFVhbVJFVG0xT2MyUXpiR0ZPV0ZwWVRrVm9VMXB0WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17833839322467604636/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhZWsxRmEzZFVhbVJFVG0xT2MyUXpiR0ZPV0ZwWVRrVm9VMXB0WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/17833839322467604636/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhZWsxRmEzZFVhbVJFVG0xT2MyUXpiR0ZPV0ZwWVRrVm9VMXB0WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/17833839322467604636/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRhZWsxRmEzZFVhbVJFVG0xT2MyUXpiR0ZPV0ZwWVRrVm9VMXB0WXhBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Patient,
